messages:
Ari: catching up from the console review  small pattern suggestions: table action cells look cramped when we show inline dropdown + ghost button at narrow widths. thinking we can tighten the outer cell padding and add a slightly larger separator between the primary action and inline controls to preserve clarity.
Noor: do you have numbers for the current paddings? i'd like to avoid shifting other table layouts.
Ari: current tokens:
```
--table-cell-pt: 12px;
--table-cell-pb: 12px;
--table-cell-pl: 16px;
--table-cell-pr: 16px;
--table-inline-gap: 10px;
```
proposal: reduce left/right padding to 12px, keep top/bottom at 12px, and increase inline gap to 14px for action separation. new tokens:
```
--table-cell-pl-compact: 12px;
--table-cell-pr-compact: 12px;
--table-inline-gap-extended: 14px;
```
Ben: increasing inline gap seems counterintuitive if we're reducing outer padding. won't that make an action cluster wider?
Ari: it spaces actions inside the cell so icons don't butt up against each other; overall cell width will be slightly smaller because of reduced pl/pr but internal affordance is maintained.
Sofia: accessibility check: when icons are closer horizontally with reduced padding, screen reader focus order still follows DOM, but visual separation helps. can we add `aria-label` on the ghost button when its visible-only label collapses? also the focus ring on ghost looks weak at 1px.
Noor: i like the aria-label addition. for focus, what about using a condensed focus token that increases stroke but keeps a subtle outer shadow: `focus-condensed: 2px solid var(--focus) + 1px shadow`.
Ari: noted. another UX micro-copy nit: the inline dropdown currently says "Details" which duplicates the row title. i'd prefer "Actions" or a verb like "Manage" depending on the context. any preference?
Ben: "Actions" is generic but clearer when multiple verbs present. "Manage" implies edit-like behavior. i'd default to "Actions" unless the menu is only edit/delete.
Sofia: agree on "Actions". also, toasts: QA reported a flicker when a toast appears while a row is being edited inline (the inline edit field loses focus). can we debounce toasts by 200ms on tables to avoid stealing focus?
Noor: that makes sense. maybe a table-specific toast-behavior: `.table { --toast-debounce: 200ms; }` and only apply when an input inside `.table` is focused.
Ari: sounds good. i'll update the figma with compact cell paddings, inline gap extended, `focus-condensed` token, change menu label to "Actions", and add toast debounce note. QA: can you run a quick script to simulate inline edit + toast to confirm debounce works before we ship?
qa-bot: queued test job: inline-edit-toast-debounce. Results pending.
Ben: one tiny visual request  when we bump focus stroke to 2px on ghost buttons, let's slightly increase row height by 2px to avoid visual collision.
Ari: will add `--row-height-compact: calc(var(--row-height) + 2px)` as an opt-in when `focus-condensed` is enabled.
Sofia: sounds like a good balance. thanks everyone, small changes but should feel much clearer on mobile widths.
Ari: thanks all, i'll paste the updated figma link here when ready.
